Title: Anonymous Visitor Cannot Reach A Tagged Product But Can Reach An Untagged One
Preconditions: A seeded and INDEXED pair exists in the same catalogue: taggedProduct carrying exactly one user group, and controlProduct carrying none. Both must already be in the search index - on an environment where CatalogPersonalization.EventBasedIndexation is false a freshly tagged product is NOT indexed, and this case would report a false pass. No user is signed in
Test_Data: storefrontUrl={{FRONT_URL}}; taggedProduct=live-discover(a product whose INDEXED user_groups carries exactly one real group - REQUIRED discriminator, an unindexed tag makes this case vacuous); controlProduct=live-discover(a product in the same catalogue whose indexed user_groups is the default any bucket)
Steps:
[SETUP] Confirm taggedProduct and controlProduct are seeded AND present in the search index with their intended user_groups - an unindexed fixture makes every assertion below vacuous
[NAV] Open storefrontUrl in a session with no signed-in user
[ACT] Search the storefront for controlProduct by its SKU
[WAIT] The result list renders
[ACT] Search the storefront for taggedProduct by its SKU
[WAIT] The result list renders
[NAV] Request taggedProduct's product page directly by its URL
Cross_Layer_Checks:
[CONSOLE] no TypeError or JS error on the page under test
[NETWORK] no 4xx/5xx on /graphql
Failure_Signals: Spinner visible >5s, console.error with TypeError, 4xx/5xx on /graphql
Cleanup: Leave the seeded fixture in place for the suite; if the case tagged anything itself, clear the tag and trigger the reindex that makes the catalogue visible again, then confirm the control product is reachable anonymously
